capabilities.description: Generate intrinsic identities, prototype links, properties, attributes, names, lengths, callable adapters, and support entries from one declarative manifest.
Map every ECMAScript language value and data-block representation to runtime tags, storage, identity, numeric domains, GC, and representation invariants.
Turn ECMA-262 conformance, implementation limit, error-handling, and product-profile prose into explicit manifests, tests, and final report evidence.
Implement Annex B semantics or make a deliberate final product-profile decision with exact tested refusals; temporary omission is not full completion.
Provide typed compile-away specification records, Lists, Completion/Reference/Descriptor forms, and narrow abrupt-completion capture with verified compiler lowering.
Provide representation-level byte blocks, raw byte conversion, agents, waiter lists, context switching, and GC/weak-retention services beneath JSL policy.
Transcribe reviewed semantic abstract-operation families into JSL with spec records, dependency-closure lowering, focused differentials, and mapped Test262 evidence.
Implement or explicitly exclude the agents/shared-memory memory model, including event records, candidate execution relations, tear-free reads, races, and host synchronization boundaries.
Map evaluation, declaration-instantiation, and module lifecycle structure to frontend handlers while proving every observable semantic suboperation delegates to JSL.
Map every syntax-directed Static Semantics operation to resolver, early-error, or parser evidence.
Map every syntax-directed Runtime Semantics operation to frontend structural lowering and prove that observable suboperations delegate to JSL.
Implement spec-shaped internal, concrete, and numeric methods in JSL across ordinary and exotic receiver families with representation services below the semantic boundary.
Transcribe every built-in algorithm into JSL, publish it declaratively, and attach Levels 0-5 focused and mapped Test262 evidence.
Map every pinned normative grammar production to parser acceptance and rejection evidence, including parameterized productions and early-error interactions.
Declare each ECMA-262 host hook and implementation-defined choice, then prove its behavior or precise refusal with focused host-policy tests.
